title: Synthetic Electronic Health Records Data using MIMIC-III
summary: A set of Jupyter notebooks that generate synthetic versions of MIMIC-III ICU tables (chart events, procedures, output events) for electronic health record research. The notebooks call SDV's constraint and evaluation utilities to enforce fixed value combinations and score the generated tables against the real data.
evidence: SDV_chartevents_generation.ipynb: 'from sdv.constraints import FixedCombinations' and 'from sdv.evaluation import evaluate'
